name: is-this-an-app
description: Use this skill when a founder has a new product idea and is about to build it, to decide what form the idea should take: a web app, a mobile app, a browser extension, an automation, an agent skill, an API, or no build at all. Also use when the user says 'is this an app,' 'does this need to be a web app,' 'should this be a SaaS,' 'web app or Chrome extension,' 'could this just be a Zapier or a GPT,' 'mobile app or web app,' 'what should I build this as,' or describes an idea and says they are abo
